notes:
Inbound lead from docs RAG guide -> sign-up. Building a support search + RAG assistant for SMB customers. Current stack: Next.js front end on Vercel, backend on Node, Postgres (hosted) with pgvector for vector storage. Wants to simplify pipeline by using Redwood hosted API for embeddings + on-the-fly reranking instead of maintaining separate embed service.

Key requirements / asks:
- Workload: embeddings for KB + reranking for top-k results (hybrid retrieval -> embed + rerank).
- Scale target: 10-25 QPS peak, ~150ms-250ms p95 target for query+rerank (want under 200ms if possible).
- Dataset: initial POC 50k docs, plan to scale to 200k docs within 2 months.
- Cost sensitivity: high; asking for per-embedding and per-token estimates and batching/async options.
- Models: open model preference (Llama2 family or open embeddings) but willing to consider Redwood curated model if cheaper.
- Integrations: concrete examples for pgvector, Supabase vector, and Pinecone; code snippets for node/TypeScript.
- Security: Okta SSO required for internal console, audit logs for ingest and inference, US data residency. KMS for key management is a nice-to-have.

Notes from discovery call:
- "Prefer self-serve — want to move quickly, but need a short security checklist for legal." — Head of Product.
- SE Rafael asked about reranking latency + tokenization costs; customer worried about double-cost (embedding + rerank) on queries.
- They asked whether Redwood supports batch-embedding ingestion endpoints and streaming rerank responses.

POC proposal (short):
1) Provide quickstart repo + 7-day trial credits.
2) Ingest 50k-doc sample (support KB + ticket snippets) into their pgvector instance, run baseline embeddings with current provider.
3) Run Redwood hosted API to re-embed a small slice and perform rerank experiments (measure recall, MRR, latency).
4) Deliver short report with cost/latency tradeoffs and recommended batching/quantization settings.

Open items / blockers:
- Internal budget approval (finance).
- Security wants explicit answers on audit logging retention and deletion flows.
- Engineering wants example code to integrate Redwood -> pgvector (upsert + query flow).

- SE send pgvector + Supabase integration examples and short sample repo (Rafael) — in progress.
